name: waveline
description: Ask about Waveline calls, texts and contacts; review transcripts and analytics; set up automatic private reply suggestions; manage inbox settings; and send explicitly approved messages.

interface.shortDescription: Ask about calls, texts, and contacts.
interface.longDescription: Connect your Waveline account to ask about calls, missed calls, voicemails, text conversations and contacts by inbox, teammate or customer, read saved transcripts and summaries, and review call analytics. Ask for automatic private reply suggestions to have the assistant set up incoming-text monitoring and save replies in Waveline for review in an Events-capable host. Sign in as yourself and review the requested permissions and integration pricing during connection setup; the assistant follows your current Waveline access. Optional actions update contacts, add notes, manage inbox settings, and send approved text messages.
defaultPrompt: Which text conversations are waiting for a reply?
Automatically save reply suggestions in Waveline when customer texts arrive. Help me choose the inboxes.
